clearedSpotChecks.check: Upcoming fork, Lagoon, judged from the develop source on 2026-11-25: can a native take (P1), a token take (P2), a sync (P3) or a hook call (P5) aimed at SuperchainETHBridge or ETHLiquidity move value that the caller does not owe.
clearedSpotChecks.note: I fetched both develop sources. SuperchainETHBridge.sol (138 lines) and ETHLiquidity.sol (107 lines) declare no receive or fallback. burn and mint require msg.sender == Predeploys.SUPERCHAIN_ETH_BRIDGE (ETHLiquidity.sol lines 64 and 72), and relayETH, refundETH and mint deliver ETH with new SafeSend (SuperchainETHBridge.sol lines 101 and 134, ETHLiquidity.sol line 74). Predeploys.sol on develop puts the bridge at 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000024 and ETHLiquidity at 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000025. On OP Mainnet and Unichain I read the EIP-1967 implementation slot of both addresses with eth_getStorageAt and got zero, and an eth_call with value 1 and empty calldata from the PoolManager address reverted with 'Proxy: implementation not initialized' on all four. In the code, _settle credits msg.value when no currency is synced (src/PoolManager.sol:353-354), sync(address(0)) only resets the synced currency (src/PoolManager.sol:281-283), and the PoolManager source has no receive or fallback, so ETH pushed in by SafeSend raises address(this).balance (src/types/Currency.sol:90-92) without crediting any delta. The clearance holds for today. It rests on develop source for the future fork, which the unit already carries as a medium lead.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Whether Base v1.5.6 runs an interpreter other than revm EthInstructions, or links a ruint release from the October 2026 rewrite, through its evm2 crate.
clearedSpotChecks.note: evm.rs at tag v1.5.6 fixes type Instructions = EthInstructions<EthInterpreter, BaseContext<DB>> (line 125) and EthFrame<EthInterpreter> (line 127). The v1.5.6 Cargo.lock holds a single ruint at 1.19.0, revm 42.0.1 and revm-interpreter 42.0.0. The lockfile does list base-common-evm2 and the git crate evm2 (alloy-rs/evm2 rev 9b03744), so evm2 is compiled in the workspace, but I parsed every package entry and no package depends on base-common-evm2, and evm2's own dependency list has no ruint. The crate README says it is intentionally not wired into the node. crates.io lists ruint 1.21.1 (2026-10-23) as the newest release. The clearance holds.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Rerun of battery.py, targeted.py, pmdiff.py (250 scripts), pmdiff2.py (300 scripts), swaps.py and replay.py on the seven chains on 2026-11-25, at the builds the endpoints report.
clearedSpotChecks.note: The work logs show 99,985 battery and 85,544 targeted vectors with 0 mismatches and 0 errors on all seven chains, pmdiff 250 of 250 and pmdiff2 300 of 300 identical, 0 tick mismatches in swaps.log, and the six failed Ink replays reported only as 'no spacing reproduced it', which replay2-57073.log then matches (3,074 swaps, 0 mismatch, 0 unmatched). I ran one independent edge vector myself: MULMOD(2^256-1, 2^256-1, 2^256-3) by eth_call with a code override returned 4 on OP Mainnet, Base and Unichain, the value Python computes. One limit to note: pmdiff runs the Ethereum bytecode (24,009 bytes) under state override, while the PoolManager deployed on Unichain has 24,050 bytes (eth_getCode, sha256 prefix 8cc5a065c50fd993). That does not weaken the clearance for the build under review, which is the 24,009 byte build of src/ (OPCODES.md line 142), but the scripts say nothing about the existing Unichain deployment.
